## Correlation detections

Aggregate detections (Sigma correlation rules) proven by `rasd correlate`: event-sequence scenarios, parameter mutants, aggregation parity of the generated SPL and KQL, and the burst guarantee.

| Correlation | Condition | Scenarios | Parameter mutants | Aggregation parity | Guaranteed burst |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [T1110.003_password_spray_burst](../detect/correlations/T1110.003_password_spray_burst/) | >= 5 distinct TargetUserName per IpAddress in 10m windows | 12 (6 fire) | 7/7 killed | 1296 runs, identical | 9+ always alert |
| [T1190_api_auth_probing](../detect/correlations/T1190_api_auth_probing/) | >= 5 distinct cs-uri-stem per c-ip in 5m windows | 11 (3 fire) | 5/5 killed | 966 runs, identical | 9+ always alert |
| [T1190_object_id_enumeration](../detect/correlations/T1190_object_id_enumeration/) | >= 3 distinct cs-uri-stem per c-ip in 1m windows | 10 (4 fire) | 5/5 killed | 960 runs, identical | 5+ always alert |
| [T1558.003_kerberoasting_volume](../detect/correlations/T1558.003_kerberoasting_volume/) | >= 5 distinct ServiceName per IpAddress in 10m windows | 10 (5 fire) | 7/7 killed | 1280 runs, identical | 9+ always alert |

## Offensive tests without a detection yet

These tests run and produce telemetry today; the gap is measured, documented and planned rather than hidden.

| Test | Platform | ATT&CK | State | Planned |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [LDAP enumeration of users, groups and SPNs](../red/active_directory/ldap_enumeration/) | active directory | [T1087.002](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1087/002/) | gap | A decoy-account rule (4662 read of a honeypot SPN user, which no legitimate process touches) and a hunt over 1644 for (servicePrincipalName=*) from workstations. |
| [Read-only privilege-escalation reconnaissance](../red/linux/privilege_escalation_checks/) | linux | [T1083](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1083/) | gap | A correlation over Sysmon for Linux process creation: find -perm -4000, getcap -r and sudo -l from one parent session within a short window, measured against a Linux administration baseline before it is enabled. |
| [File upload restrictions](../red/web/file_upload_testing/) | web | [T1505.003](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1505/003/) | gap | A WAF-log rule for executable or double extensions on upload endpoints, once a WAF log source is mapped. |
| [JWT validation (unsigned and tampered tokens)](../red/web/jwt_testing/) | web | [T1606](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1606/) | gap | A rule on application logs for JWT validation failures with algorithm none, once an application log source is mapped. |
| [HTTP security headers and cookie flags](../red/web/security_headers_testing/) | web | - | posture check | configuration review, no detection expected |
